title: Nakanishi2015 – SSVEP Nakanishi 2015 dataset
description: A 12-class steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) EEG dataset using joint frequency-phase modulation, recorded from healthy participants during a simulated online brain-computer interface experiment. Eight occipital and parieto-occipital channels were recorded at 256 Hz while subjects gazed at flickering targets on a 4x3 virtual keypad. The data were originally used to compare canonical correlation analysis (CCA) based SSVEP detection methods.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Biosemi ActiveTwo amplifier from 8 channels (PO7, PO3, POz, PO4, PO8, O1, Oz, O2) with CMS/DRL reference. Subjects gazed at one of 12 flickering targets (9.25-14.75 Hz, 0.5 Hz spacing) for 4 s per trial, over 15 blocks of 12 trials. Stimuli were presented in MATLAB with Psychophysics Toolbox on a 60 Hz LCD monitor. Data were downsampled to 256 Hz and bandpass filtered at 6-80 Hz with zero-phase IIR filtering, and epochs were extracted with a 135 ms latency delay.
